I fixed `slugify` in `src/slugify.py`, but I haven't run the tests. Bash was denied in this session, so the fix is checked only by reading the code against the tests.

You didn't say what was going wrong, so I went by the code and the tests. The old version replaced every non-alphanumeric character with its own dash. `"  a   b  "` came out as `a---b` and `"C++ rocks!"` as `c---rocks-`. The new line is `re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")`. It collapses each run into one dash and strips dashes from the ends. Tracing the five tests by hand, they should all pass.

If "not working" meant something else, such as a failure outside this repo, tell me what you saw. You can also allow Bash so I can run `pytest`.
